notes.title: MORE ABOUT THE UPCOMING STORIES
notes.content:
Hey there, friends! 

Now that the Fool’s Day is over you can take us seriously, no joke. I’m pleased to tell you that the spring discounts are still here - you can get almost all of our games and DLCs with a  50% discount! Now, isn’t it a steal? Enjoy the casual one hand gaming ːls_heartː

I bet you can’t wait for the Sex And The Furry Titty 3 to roll in as soon as possible, and you’re dying to know what’s in our pockets in terms of the stories. I guess it’s time to introduce you to the new plots. Buckle up, we’re rolling into the City!

Résidence à trois

Owning an apartment? In this economy? No, thanks! It’s not your thought, though, you’d rather be the owner than to go through the renting hell again, Yet, here you are - in front of the apartment complex, desperate to find a corner for yourself. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/e5e405fae58c994b44737d6b0c0fae6ab336149d.png

It just so happens that you’re dumb enough to confuse the buildings and find yourself in front of two gorgeous girls wanting to show you the apartment. And you’re not in the position to stand there and think of the world problems. So, naturally, you take the free spot. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/fc4525380be5eca703cc767b5f94a6d7da877621.png

And the girls are absolutely amazing and a little bit crazy, but it’s fine, as long as you three are in good terms. Will you be able to conquer their hearts with delicious home-made food and a little bit of care for them both? 

Smells Like Sex Spirit

Ashley and Curt dream of becoming the biggest rock stars of all times. They are also hopelessly in love with each other, and none of them knows it. Except for, maybe, their friends who are, by the way, always the first ones to disappear after the practice. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/2af5e31d6061d9a5057eb288c194ee3704b1a387.png

Curt is kind and cute, and strong and… Ashley really wants him to turn his gaze on her. So, she takes every opportunity to spend more time with him. Gladly, there’s always a lot to do, like cleaning up the garage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/6add1a80deb01709b7a87874293682aedb2c7e47.png

Will be Curt brave enough to finally notice her romantic moves and accept her feelings, or is he just another brick in the wall? Find out in Sex And The Furry Titty 3!
